shown.message:
Outline rev 16 is pushed. The positive control from `experiment-repo`#9 finished on the MT-Bench human graph. It changes how C4 reads. The Arena-55k cells are still running.

- **Δ has no demonstrated power.** It missed every injected departure at every size tried (overdispersion, position bias, cyclic component, pair-specific deviation). Every pooled interval stayed inside ±0.15, and the largest |Δ| was 0.041. Overdispersion that raised the SE to 2.26× the model SE (design effect 6.2) moved Δ by at most 0.01. The SE ratio did see it, going from 0.82 to 2.26.
- **What the paper may say:** Δ is not a misfit test, and the small real Δ is not evidence that BT fits. The design-effect statement rests on the SE ratio. The one real design effect is MT-Bench human, at 2.39. "No misfit" is never written.
- **Arena-55k flip:** the real Δ is 0.056 [0.013, 0.099]. Data simulated from the fitted BT on that graph, with no departure, give 0.045 [0.036, 0.054]. So most of the 0.056 is an offset of the null, not a real-data effect.
- **H2 sent to `idea-repo`:** I opened `idea-repo`#8 saying H2 can't be tested with Δ. I proposed restating it in terms of the SE ratio and the matched contrasts, with Δ as a gauge. I think this sharpens the lead, since the counts, the null, noise versus adversary and survival are unaffected.
- **Paper side:** `paper-repo` has already put the positive control into the paper and says Δ does not respond to the departures tried. I haven't re-read that text against rev 16.

Commitment #2 stays open.
